svg.title: DMG-D1a metal wing into a trunk
svg.text: DMG-D1a: metal Cessna at 30 m/s, the wing 2.5 m out - from above 0.6 s after the first break; broken by seam, kinked members ringed (20 broken then)
by the end (5 s): first member wing (no seam) (fold); groups wing0L:strut; 20 broken, 0 kink floors, 0 spruce cracks
